description: Constructed trace of a compliant attended create run for eval 10, not an agent capture: the branch where the auth pre-flight passes with a warning. The planner confirms cr_widget is absent by an exact logical-name search; check-auth.js then returns ok:true with identitiesMatch:false (az and pac are signed in as different identities, and WhoAmI works). The orchestrator shows the one-line warning verbatim, with its az login --username fix for the pac identity, and goes on: the entity-builder provisions cr_widget (its re-probes return the same warning, which it logs in its transaction log), the user declines sample data, and the page is uploaded with cr_widget as its data source. tool-results.json records every logged command in order.
